title: MusicDrop v1.7.2 — HD TV Video Player & TV Categories
changelog:
• HD TV Video Player: Watch YouTube music videos in full-screen HD on your TV screen with one click!
• Video ↔ Vinyl Audio Switch: Seamlessly toggle between full-screen video mode and spinning vinyl art with TV remote
• In-Player & TV Downloads: Download songs directly from the player overlay with a single remote click
• TV-Optimized Card Sizing: Sleek 16:9 cards (5-6 visible across) replacing oversized mobile cards
• TV Category Chips & Navigation: Instant mood & category switching (Trending, Bollywood, Malayalam, Tamil, Lofi, Workout, Romantic)
• Dedicated Downloads Screen: View and play offline saved tracks from the sidebar
